fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.qz.summary: Receive live traffic news via Traffic Message Channel (TMC)
fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.qz.description:
Receive live traffic news via Traffic Message Channel (TMC)
Qz (pronounced “queues”) connects to an RDS/TMC receiver to receive live traffic messages. TMC is transmitted in the RDS data stream of various radio channels and provides live traffic information, helping you avoid congestions.
For a list of countries in which this app can be used, see https://gitlab.com/mvglasow/qz/wikis/countries.
In order to use this app, you will need a supported RDS/TMC receiver. The following devices are currently supported:
* GNS FM9-BT (requires Bluetooth)
* Silicon Labs Si4701/4703-based USB tuners (requires USB OTG support)
If you are unable to pick up any traffic messages, despite having a supported device and being in an area which should be supported, check your antenna. Reception with pigtail antennas (a long piece of wire coming out of the receiver) is generally poor and insufficient for TMC. It is recommended to rely on your vehicle antenna, a building antenna or a somewhat decent room antenna.
Qz will only work with unencrypted TMC services (as encrypted services require paying a per-device royalty). Also, some countries have chosen to require paying a royalty for access to their location tables (which Qz needs to decode TMC locations) and are therefore not supported.

fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.name: Nonius
fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.summary: Ten measuring instruments. No ads, no trackers, no network.
fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.description:
Your phone has a gravity sensor, a magnetometer, a barometer, a light sensor and a microphone. Android gives you none of them. The apps that fill the gap are mostly a banner ad with a bubble drawn on top.
Nonius is the other kind. Every face is drawn as an instrument rather than assembled from stock components, and every reading that depends on hardware has a calibration you can set, because no sensor is perfect and no screen reports its own size honestly.
 The instruments 
• Level , a round vial and a tube at once, with a zero point stored for your device, in degrees, percent or millimetres per metre
• Compass , heading and field strength, true north from a declination you set since there is no location permission to find it for you, and the same face doubles as a metal detector for finding a nail behind plaster
• Ruler , millimetres and inches, calibrated against a bank card rather than against the pixel density the panel claims
• Sound level , in dB(A) or dB(Z), with peak and minimum hold, asking the device for the unprocessed microphone so that gain control cannot rewrite the number
• Tuner , note and cents by YIN pitch detection, concert pitch adjustable from 415 to 466 Hz
• Counter , a tally you tap anywhere or raise with the volume keys, which survives closing the app
• Altimeter , height above a mark you set, exact enough to measure a staircase, with the pressure trend
• Light meter , lux across six decades, from moonlight to direct sun
• Metronome , BPM 30 to 250 and beats per bar 1 to 12 with the first beat accented, sample-accurate clicks
• G-force , the magnitude of the three accelerometer axes against standard gravity, with peak hold
Instruments your device has no sensor for are shown greyed out with the reason, instead of opening and then apologising.
 What it does not do 
There is no INTERNET permission in the manifest, so the app cannot send anything anywhere even by accident. The single permission is the microphone, requested when you open the sound level meter or the tuner. Nothing is recorded: each frame of audio becomes one number and is discarded. The only thing stored is the handful of calibration values for your device.
Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.

fdroid:dev.leeeet.wallpapermoe.description:
Wallpaper Moe is a live wallpaper that changes itself. It gets wallpapers from online collections, from a folder on your device, or from your favorites. A change occurs when the screen goes off: each time, or at most each hour, each 6 hours or each day.
Features
- Home and lock screen: both screens can use one source, or each screen can have its own source and frequency. Each screen has its own brightness, contrast and blur.
- Sources that you build: a source can use other sources, so you configure a source one time.
- History and favorites: the last 20 wallpapers stay on the device at full size. You can put favorites in order.
- Viewer: swipe and zoom, set as wallpaper, save to the gallery, share, or open the source page.
- Next wallpaper tile in Quick Settings.
- Wallpaper colors for the system theme.
- Automatic changes can wait for an unmetered network.
- Backup and restore of sources, settings and favorites.
Sources
- Wallhaven searches wallhaven.cc by text, category, purity, aspect ratio and order.
- Nekos.best gets anime artwork from the kinds that you select.
- Pandora gets images from Xiaomi's public wallpaper channels.
- Device folder uses the images in a folder on your device.
- Favorites uses the wallpapers that you marked with a heart, at random or in your order.
- Keep ready prepares wallpapers before a change, saves wallpapers for later, or both.
- Combine uses two or more sources at random, in turn, or as fallbacks.
Privacy
Wallpaper Moe has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. All data stays on the device. The app connects only to the providers of the sources that you configure. Pandora requests contain the app version, the language, the screen width, the time and a random identifier for this installation. The app sends your Wallhaven API key only for searches that include NSFW images.
Wallpaper Moe requires Android 14 or newer. It has no connection with wallhaven.cc, Nekos.best or Xiaomi, and they do not endorse it. The terms of the creators and providers apply to the wallpaper images.

 only once: If you need something like a new knive or some new plates e.g. there is the "only once" option where the item automatically gets deleted as soon as you got it once.

firefox-addons:2988462.summary: Automatically removes tracking parameters from links and URLs, including utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, ttclid, and 50+ others, so you can browse, copy, and share cleaner links with better privacy.
firefox-addons:2988462.description:
CleanLink automatically removes tracking parameters from URLs before pages load, so links stay cleaner, shorter, and more private.
It strips common trackers such as utm_* , fbclid , gclid , msclkid , ttclid , twclid , mkt_tok , mc_cid , and many others.
 Main features 
- Automatically cleans tracking parameters from links during browsing
- Cleans links directly on the page before you click them
- Cleans copied links so shared URLs stay private and readable
- Works quietly in the background with no setup required
- Includes an optional anonymous analytics mode that can be turned off at any time
 Why it matters 
Advertising and analytics platforms use tagged URLs to track where traffic comes from and to help build behavioral profiles. CleanLink removes those parameters before they spread through your browsing, bookmarks, clipboard, and shared links.
 Anonymous analytics 
If enabled, CleanLink sends only limited anonymized technical and usage data:
- visited domain
- event date and time
- country code
- random install ID
- browser language
- basic browser metadata
 What CleanLink does not collect 
- names
- email addresses
- passwords
- form contents
- cookies
- messages
- page contents
- precise location
 Data use 
Anonymous data is used only for:
- debugging extension behavior
- improving tracker detection
- understanding which trackers appear most often
- measuring which websites use tracking parameters most heavily
 We never sell user data. 
Read more in the built-in Privacy Policy .

firefox-addons:549252.name: AdBlocker Lite
firefox-addons:549252.summary: block ads seamlessly on popular websites
firefox-addons:549252.description:
AdBlocker Lite is a browser add-on that enables you to block annoying ads seamlessly on popular websites. It has 2 modes, Lite and Full. In lite mode, the extension uses the least amount of CPU power and memory and it runs based on pure CSS. Lite mode is ideal for slow machines. In full mode, more ads are targeted and more CPU power and memory are required.
Some important features:
1. It allows you to block annoying ads, scripts, images, iframes and many more.
2. Ultra-lite extension with no significant memory and CPU usage.
3. Unlike other similar products, AdBlocker Lite uses hard coded filtering rules for fast and reliable performance.
4. Provides an easy access filtering list if you wish to allow advertisement on some websites.
5. Includes ON|OFF button to quickly disable or enable the extension.
6. Includes Highlight/Block modes; in highlight mode, you can only highlight ads without blocking (hiding) them, but in block mode, ads are blocked.
7. Easily switch between full and lite modes (default is lite mode).
8. Add custom blocking rules. Currently, only rules in the form of css-selectors are accepted.
9. Badge icon text shows the number of blocked ads (active in full mode only).
Note 1: In AdBlocker Lite you can allow some websites (including its homepage) to show non-intrusive advertisements. By doing this you support websites that rely on advertising. Some websites are added by default, but this list can be modified at any time.
Note 2: AdBlocker Lite is designed to block ads on popular websites only (i.e. facebook, youtube, gmail, yahoo mail, etc). Besides, it does not block popup-ads, if you need a full-featured adblocker please use other adblocker addons in the addon store.
Note 3: To add a custom rule, please use css-selectors. For example, the following rule hides a div element with class test: div[class='test']. Please note, you can only add valid CSS rules, otherwise, it won't be added to the list.

firefox-addons:814814.name: Stylus
firefox-addons:814814.summary: Redesign your favorite websites with Stylus, an actively developed and community driven userstyles manager. Easily install custom themes from popular online repositories, or create, edit, and manage your own personalized CSS stylesheets.
firefox-addons:814814.description:
Redesign your favorite websites with Stylus, an actively developed and community driven userstyles manager. Easily install custom themes from popular online repositories, or create, edit, and manage your own personalized CSS stylesheets. Features
  • Versatility of theme installation options. Stylus supports installs from popular online repositories. Additionally, styles can now also be installed from .user.css or .user.styl URLs (see Usercss format documentation in our github wiki).
  • A backup feature for your entire database of installed styles which is compatible with other userstyles managers.
  • An intuitive and configurable automatic update function for installed styles.
  • A highly customizable UI, including theming, optional layouts, icon and badge color choices, along with many other tweaks.
  • Two different optional code validators with user configurable rules.
Useful Links
  • Source code: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus
  • Video tutorial: https://youtu.be/fCVvGwoF5cQ
  • Chat room: https://discord.gg/tzXVNJz
  • Frequently asked questions: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/FAQ
  • Technical bug report: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/issues
  • General discussion and bug report: https://add0n.com/stylus.html#reviews
  • Localization: https://www.transifex.com/github-7/Stylus/dashboard/
Permissions Stylus uses only a small subset of each permission. As you can see in WebExtensions API documentation or simplified tutorials, there's no way to apply any modifications to a web page without gaining the full access permission to that page. Stylus is mostly used to apply global themes, which is why it requests a global permission. In the future we might be able to implement a more granular approach but it's not exactly trivial.
  • Access your data for all websites - required for the style elements to be added into the page, not to access any of your data.
  • Access browser tabs - required to show styles in the popup, and for some auxiliary features like regexp tester in the editor.
  • Access browser activity during navigation - required to insert the styles at the exact moment the page is navigated to a different URL.
  • Identity - required for access to cloud services to allow importing and exporting of styles (e.g. Dropbox, etc).
Privacy Policy Unlike other similar extensions, we don't find you to be all that interesting. Your questionable browsing history should remain between you and the NSA. Stylus collects nothing. Period. Firefox related notes
  • To import styles from Stylish add-on please read https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/FAQ#how-can-i-export-my-user-styles-from-stylish-for-firefox-to-stylus
  • Stylus doesn't apply userstyles to the browser UI or the built-in pages like about:addons because there's no WebExtension API for dynamic application of CSS. You may use another extension that runs an externally installed companion utility to modify userChrome.css and userContent.css and restart Firefox. This restriction is imposed intentionally by Mozilla for security purposes. We don't plan to incorporate the above-mentioned workaround. See https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/Styling-Firefox-UI
  • Export backups of your database frequently. The main reason we've kept the "beta" status for so long is because WebExtension support is still a work in progress for Firefox. Many Firefox specific workarounds have been implemented, but backing up your DB regularly will save you a lot of aggravation should something happen to go wrong.

firefox-addons:2826122.summary: Use dual subtitles for language learning with Netflix, YouTube, Crunchyroll and online courses. Translator extension with pop-up dictionary: hover any word, translate meaning, save it into your vocabulary builder and learn new words.
firefox-addons:2826122.description:
InterSub turns the shows and courses you already watch into language lessons. Use dual subtitles to see the original line and its translation together, and a translator extension that explains any word you hover, in videos and on websites.
💡 What's new
• Telegram bot for practising your saved words: t.me/InterSubWords_bot?start=ff_as 
• Auto-hide subtitles on YouTube.
• Forced AI translation of the second subtitle line, based on the original.
• AI Language Buddy chat: ask about slang, grammar or usage, get extra examples without leaving the screen, and save the explanation to your vocabulary.
📺 Dual subtitles on the video you already watch
Watch with two lines on screen: the original subtitle and your language below it. It works as a dual subtitles extension on every supported site. If a video has no track in your language, the AI subtitle translator (paid plans and the free trial) can build the second line for you on the fly.
Supported platforms include:
➤ Netflix
➤ YouTube
➤ Prime Video
➤ HBO Max
➤ Disney+
➤ Crunchyroll
➤ Coursera
➤ Udemy
➤ LinkedIn Learning
➤ TED
The full list of supported sites: intersub.cc/en/how_to#skip_intro 
Turn on netflix dual subtitles for a series in the evening and youtube dual subtitles for a lecture in the morning: the settings stay the same everywhere. People also call it netflix double subtitles or netflix two subtitles; double subtitles on any supported site work the same way.
🔎 Translator extension with a pop-up dictionary
1⃣ Hover a word in the subtitles. The video pauses and a pop-up dictionary shows the translation.
2⃣ Read the context translation: the words around it are translated too, so slang and idioms make sense.
3⃣ Double-click or select text on any website. The same dictionary extension works on articles and forums.
4⃣ Ask the AI language tutor to translate meaning, grammar or a cultural reference in plain words. It's AI language learning built around your own questions.
This language translator extension recognises phrases, idioms and phrasal verbs, not only single words, so it works as an instant translator for real speech. On YouTube it doubles as a youtube translator extension for comments and descriptions too.
📚 Vocabulary builder with a full learning cycle
Most vocabulary apps give you someone else's word list. Here the list is built from the words you actually met in a scene or an article, so you learn new words you already care about.
How the cycle works:
 Find a word in a film, a series or on a website.
 It is saved to your vocabulary builder together with the sentence it came from.
 Practise it in our Telegram bot ( t.me/InterSubWords_bot?start=ff_as ). It breaks each word down into translation, usage and examples, checks the sentences you write with an AI tutor and brings the word back with spaced repetition. You can even answer by voice.
 Meet the word again in the next episode and understand it without help.
Prefer flashcards? You can also sync your words with Anki or export them to Excel. The bot follows the same idea as the extension. It stays simple and works with the words you chose yourself.
🧠 Learn from your own words
Sentence mining is simple here, with no extra add-ons to set up: every word keeps the line it came from, so you review it in context. If you use Anki, you can sync these words there too.
🎧 Modes for immersion language learning
▸ Show subtitles only on pause to train your listening.
▸ Hide the second line until you pause, then check yourself.
▸ Shadowing mode stops after each line so you can repeat it out loud. It's a simple way to practise shadowing english with real dialogue.
▸ Change font size, colour and position; right-to-left languages such as Arabic and Hebrew display correctly.
📱 Remote control from your phone
Watching on a TV or a big monitor? Scan a QR code and your phone becomes a remote: pause, rewind a line and tap a word in the current subtitle to see its translation, without leaving the sofa.
🌍 Languages you can learn
It supports dozens of languages. Popular directions include english to spanish and spanish to english, english to japanese, english to chinese and german to english. Fans who learn japanese with anime get the same tools on anime platforms, and crunchyroll ai subtitles help when an episode has no track in your language.
💡 What you get
• One app instead of three: dual subs, a pop-up dictionary and a vocabulary builder.
• Language learning with netflix and YouTube without stopping to search in another tab. It works as a netflix language learning extension.
• One of the language learning tools that covers both watching and review.
• A google translate alternative for words in context: you see what the word means in this exact sentence.
• ChatGPT translation help: ask the AI why a phrase means what it means.
• An alternative to Language Reactor, Immersive Translate, Dualsub or Trancy for learners who want both subtitles and word practice.
• Your words follow you to the phone through the Telegram bot.
❓ Frequently asked questions
Q: Is InterSub free?
A: Yes. Dual subs are free. The free plan includes a limited number of word lookups each month; Premium removes the limit and adds AI translation of subtitles.
Q: Does the translator extension work outside video?
A: Yes. Select or double-click any word on a website to see the translation.
Q: Is the Telegram bot free?
A: Yes. On the free plan you can bring 5 words from your InterSub dictionary into the bot; any paid plan makes it unlimited. You can also add your own word lists.
Q: Do I need Anki?
A: No. Words are saved in your dictionary and you can practise them in our Telegram bot. Anki sync is there if you already use it.
